description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Event' namespace. It provides event handlers for manipulating language data before and after controller actions, specifically for dumping language variables into templates, backing up current language data, and restoring it.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class that manages language data during specific events in the application lifecycle. It handles dumping language variables into templates and backing up/restoring language state during controller execution.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Injects all language variables into argument array for template rendering, ensuring all language data is available in the view.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Caches the current language data by serializing it into a JSON string and storing it under the 'backup' key.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from the backup by deserializing JSON string and resetting each language key-value pair.
